english.title: Ride a pedal cycle on a road in contravention of a direction given by traffic warden / constable / traffic officer
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[driving]_
(B)_[propelling]_

a pedal cycle, namely **(..SPECIFY MAKE..), neglected or refused

(C)_[to stop the pedal cycle]_
(D)_[to make the pedal cycle proceed in, or keep to a particular line of traffic]_

when directed to do so by a

(E)_[constable]_
(F)_[traffic warden]_
(G)_[traffic officer]_

acting in the execution of

(H)_[his]_
(I)_[her]_

duty and for the time being engaged in the regulation of traffic in a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 35(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
